title: Chapter 206 Killing Dr. Jia
content:
Chapter 206 Killing Dr. Jia

"How are you?" Wang Shuo looked at Ayub and Gong Zheng again.

Ayub stood between Dr. Jia and Wang Shuo and said in a deep voice: "Nothing serious."

As for Gong Zheng, he used his protective shield to knock down more than ten steel needles without any damage.

As long as his two generals were fine, the battle could continue.

Soon, the bronze spear was reloaded again.

The three of them interfered with Dr. Jia again. At this time, Dr. Jia's mechanical arm was transformed into a drill, and the high-speed rotating drill wanted to break Gong Zheng's shield.

Wang Shuo found the right time again and launched the "Iron Chain Binding" skill.

This time Dr. Jia was prepared and almost failed, but "Iron Chain Binding" was a directional skill and there was almost no possibility of dodging.

But this time he broke free from the chain faster than the first time.

Before Wang Shuo could call Li Jianguo, the bronze spear pierced Dr. Jia's left shoulder again and nailed him to the wall.

And his health value had dropped by more than half.

Those who still had the energy to fight again also seized the opportunity and rushed up to attack.

When Dr. Jia broke free from the spear again, everyone began to dodge.

This cycle continued until Dr. Jia's health reached the bottom, and Wang Shuo found the right time to restrain him.

The last bronze spear killed him.

[Your subordinate Li Jianguo killed the silver boss Dr. Jia. ]

After a difficult battle, everyone finally got a good reward.

The boss exploded.

Several items exploded on the spot.

Shi Lisha, Locke, and Yinghua Guzi, their eyes glowed, and they flew over to grab them regardless of their injuries.

Only Ye Xueer was tempted, but did not take action.

Wang Shuo was furious when he saw this.

He was hit by the boss's punch just now, and his health was lost by half, and he was seriously injured.

And Ayub and Gong Zheng were also in poor condition.

That's why these three people were blinded by greed.

As the saying goes, people die for money, and birds die for food.

They didn't get any benefit from the last boss, so they couldn't let Wang Shuo distribute it this time.

Wang Shuo snorted coldly, and murderous intent flashed in his eyes.

"If you dare to snatch the spoils, you will be killed without mercy."

Wang Shuo said directly to his troops.

"Block all exits."

The remaining soldiers were divided into three teams and quickly went to the remaining three exits.

Li Jianguo directly changed to black iron spears and aimed at Locke and the other two.

Gong Zheng and Ayub were also very close to the spoils, but they were half a beat slower than the other three.

They picked up the spoils while getting into a melee.

Wang Shuo directly took out a bottle of life potion mixed with water of life and drank a sip.

His health value recovered rapidly at a speed visible to the naked eye.

He rushed over quickly with his spear dancing.

The closest to him was the yellow-haired Locke. Wang Shuo watched him put a blueprint into his backpack.

Wang Shuo valued this kind of thing the most and directly launched the "iron chain binding".

These three people were simply blinded by greed and didn't consider whether they could rob Wang Shuo and others.

The spear stabbed straight to Locke's abdomen.

Locke raised his shield to block, and at the same time, the spear in his hand began to counterattack and stabbed Wang Shuo's face.

Gong Zheng's opponent was Shi Lisha.

After receiving Wang Shuo's order, Gong Zheng directly used a move "Taishan Pressure".

This is a skill that Gong Zheng learned after killing Toad Brunei.

[Taishan Pressure: Consume 100 points of mental power, suddenly jump into the air, and perform shield strikes on targets within 50 meters, causing 5% of the target's own health value damage, additional stun for 2 seconds, skill CD: 10 minutes. ]

The reason why it was not used on the boss just now was that Gong Zheng was able to withstand the opponent's damage on the one hand, and on the other hand, Wang Shuo did it intentionally, and he had to keep some trump cards.
